verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's REST API is documented as the foundation underlying the CLI and SDK, giving programmatic parity for search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, and serverless endpoints, backed by a live OpenAPI spec and CLI docs. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that every single UI-only feature (e.g., team management, billing autobilling setup) is fully exposed via API without gaps, and no third-party audit of API-UI parity.
